messages:
mike: Heads up — after last night's deploy (rollup-aggregator v2.4.1) we're seeing pockets of negative tokens/sec and TTFT=0 in the console for stream metrics. Affects env=prod, routes: /generate/*, time windows 2026-03-16T02:00–02:15 UTC. Screenshot: https://redir.example/ss/2149.png
sofia: thanks — can you paste the exact dashboard query and a small timeseries export? is this across all shards or particular ones? :eyes:
mike: query we use in console: `select sum(tokens) / window_seconds as tokensec, avg(first_token_time_ms) as ttft from streaming_rollups where route like '/generate/%' and env='prod' group by window` Export attached (small CSV) — rows show negative tokensec: `-12`, `-8` and TTFT `0` for windows that had traffic.
raj: possible cause: out-of-order rollup replay or counter reset. Did any rollup jobs restart or get a replay around that time? check `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server x:9092 --describe --group rollup-aggregator-v2`
opsbot: alert: rollup-aggregator-v2 consumer group had 3 restarts between 2026-03-16T01:55 and 2026-03-16T02:05 — reason: OOM killed pod rollup-agg-3.
mike: we did an infra autoscaler patch 02:00 UTC that bounced some pods. Logs: `rollup-agg-3 ERROR: unexpected reset of sum counter at 1610 -> -120`
sofia: that log line suggests the incremental counter reset produced negative delta when computing windowed rate. Two immediate mitigations: 1) pause rollups and replay from checkpointed offsets; 2) run `rollup-repair --consumer-group rollup-aggregator-v2 --start 2026-03-16T01:50 --end 2026-03-16T02:20 --fix-negative` to backfill corrected deltas.
emma: any customer-facing fallout? billing implications? we need to know if tokens/sec negative affected invoicing.
mike: support ticket #S-18422 reported higher 4xx errors in that window but no billing spike. Looks like only the console numbers are corrupted, backend usage (billing pipeline) uses raw events and is fine.
raj: to reproduce locally: 1) run `kafka-producer` to emit a monotonically increasing counter, 2) simulate a counter reset by emitting a lower value to the same partition, 3) run rollup-aggregator v2.4.1 against that topic. In dev this yields negative tokensec on `windowed-delta` calculation. Patch idea: treat negative deltas as reset and replace with `current_value` or discard delta when magnitude > threshold.
mike: running repair now. will post result. if anyone wants to pair on the fix, ping me.
sofia: thanks. please add the CSV export to the bug ticket and set severity P2 for console-only metric corruption. assign to eng-runtime and eng-sre.
mike: uploaded CSV and ticket updated. starting `rollup-repair` — ETA ~7m.
